answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose to use rule-based chatbots for formal and mechanistic analysis of neural conversational agents. We first present theoretical constructions of how a Transformer can implement a classic rule-based chatbot algorithm, and then we use these constructions to guide a series of empirical investigations into how Transformers learn to solve such tasks when they are trained on synthetic conversation data.
